integrity: The new statements are reconstructed directly from the positive coefficient series underlying the source theorem, without relying on its special-function closed form. Strict monotonicity follows by differentiation of absolutely convergent series. The exponential boundary layer follows from an exact digamma decomposition, and the covering expansion follows from absolutely summable inverse-alpha expansions.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the coefficient-series univalence and covering radii furnished by the cited Landau argument. It does not independently assert optimality of those radii among all bounded mappings. The asymptotic regime keeps M fixed while alpha tends to infinity.
title: Two-scale stabilization of differential harmonic Landau radii
